description: Source code for a ModalBox web component class that manages modal dialog behavior, including show/hide, iframe handling, and state management.

classes.name: ModalBox
classes.description: A custom web component class extending EmbedElement to implement modal dialog functionality with state handling, iframe management, and event dispatching.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays or hides the modal box, adjusting visibility and body overflow.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the modal if not in prerendering state, dispatching an 'open' event.

methods.name: isLoaderRunning
methods.description: Checks if the loader is currently active based on the 'state' attribute.

methods.name: explicitClose
methods.description: Closes the modal and dispatches a 'close' event.

methods.name: isShowingMessage
methods.description: Determines if the modal is showing a message or failed state.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the modal unless loader is active or message is showing.

methods.name: collapseIframe
methods.description: Hides the iframe by setting display to 'none'.

methods.name: uncollapseIframe
methods.description: Restores iframe display to default.

methods.name: makeIframeInvisible
methods.description: Sets iframe visibility to hidden.

methods.name: makeIframeVisible
methods.description: Sets iframe visibility to visible.

methods.name: getMessageElement
methods.description: Retrieves the message element from shadow DOM, throws if not found.

methods.name: getMessageContainerElement
methods.description: Retrieves the message container element, throws if not found.

methods.name: toggleMessageElement
methods.description: Shows or hides the message container.

methods.name: ensureIframeFullyVisible
methods.description: Makes iframe visible and uncollapsed.

methods.name: onStateLoaded
methods.description: Handles actions when state is 'loaded', hides loader, message, and opens modal.

methods.name: onStateFailedOrMessage
methods.description: Handles 'failed' or 'has-message' states, shows message, collapses iframe.

methods.name: attributeChangedCallback
methods.description: Responds to changes in 'state' attribute, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: connectedCallback
methods.description: Sets up event listeners and initializes component.

methods.name: disconnectedCallback
methods.description: Removes event listeners.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ModalBox component, sets inner HTML, and manages overflow.
